full_judgment: 12. Dr Shahdeen Malik of course was unable to show any particular decision which has direct bearing on the issue since this an issue has been raised in the first time for decision i.e. the office of the Vice-Chancellor of the said University is challenged on the ground that the Vice-Chancellor appointed by the President has no decree in Science and Technology. Of course on our asking the learned counsel has given references of several decisions where the writ quo warranto was successful. The particular cases are Abul Bashar vs Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed, 49 DLR 1; Ruhul Quddus, Advocate vs Justice MA Aziz, 60 DLR 511; Shamsul Hoque Chowdhury vs Justice Md Abdur Rouf, 49 DLR 176 etc. and also Law Dev (Bangladesh) vs Bangladesh, 63 DLR 626; Aminul Hoque vs Justice Sultan Hossain Khan, 11 BLC 339; Amena Begum vs Bangladesh, 3 ALR 71; and so on. It is really appreciable that Dr Shahdeen Malik took much pain in preparing a reply dated 14-3-2018 by way of affidavit-in-reply to the affidavit-in-opposition submitted by respondent No.1. He has categorized all the factual aspects together with his submissions precisely, meticulously and with precision.
